The test now does `get :comments, embed_url: embed_url` with no referer stub, so failure is attributable to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` being false for a nil/absent referer (same underlying reason as the later "raises an error with no referer" test), not specifically to the embeddable_hosts table being empty. This weakens coverage of the intended scenario but doesn’t by itself indicate a production defect.
